clue.text: Speak loudly about ship's old club

indicators.note: about means one piece goes round the other, so the loud speaking surrounds the ship

parts.note: to bray is to speak or laugh loudly and harshly, like a donkey
SS is steamship, the usual prefix to a ship's name

explanation.surface: Someone shouts about a vessel's historic sports club.
explanation.walkthrough: A brassy (or brassie) was an old wooden golf club with a brass sole, number 2 wood in modern terms.
explanation.definitionFit: The brassie was a golf wood of earlier times, its sole plated with brass.

clue.text: Leading rower trips awkwardly on vessel's prow

parts.note: the bow is the oarsman seated nearest the front of the boat

indicators.note: awkwardly means the letters are put together clumsily, so rearranged

explanation.surface: The front oarsman stumbles over the front of the boat.
explanation.definitionFit: The bowsprit is the spar projecting forward from a sailing ship's bow.

clue.text: Empty-headed flirtation leads to marriage

indicators.note: empty-headed says the word loses its head, its first letter

parts.note: dalliance is casual flirting or amorous play

explanation.surface: A frivolous affair ends up at the altar.
explanation.definitionFit: An alliance is a union, including one between families by marriage.

clue.text: Foreign food to some extent gives us hiccups

indicators.note: to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A dish from abroad partly gives us the hiccups.
explanation.definitionFit: Sushi is a Japanese dish of vinegared rice with raw fish, foreign food to Britons.

clue.text: Strike-breaker promises to supply plant

parts.note: a scab is a worker who crosses a picket line
IOUs are written promises to pay a debt

explanation.surface: A blackleg pledges to provide some greenery.
explanation.definitionFit: Scabious is a meadow flower with pincushion-like blue or lilac heads.

clue.text: Snooty prisoner's going down

parts.note: a con is a convict, a prisoner
descending means going down

explanation.surface: A stuck-up inmate is being sent down.
explanation.definitionFit: Condescending means patronising, looking down on others, so snooty.

clue.text: Cold tea consumed by trite reveller

indicators.note: consumed by means swallowed inside the other word

parts.note: banal means trite, commonplace
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
cha is slang for tea

explanation.surface: A dull partygoer drinks chilled tea.
explanation.definitionFit: A bacchanal is a drunken carouser, after Bacchus the god of wine.

clue.text: Started to write in dictionary

indicators.note: in puts the writing word inside the dictionary

parts.note: OED is the Oxford English Dictionary
to pen is to write

explanation.surface: Someone began writing in a reference book.
explanation.definitionFit: Opened means began, as in opened the meeting.

clue.text: Islander initially shot a grouse

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of the following word

parts.note: to grouse is to grumble or moan

explanation.surface: An islander first shot a game bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grouse' looks like the game bird but is the verb meaning complain.
explanation.definitionFit: A Samoan is a native of Samoa in the South Pacific islands.

clue.text: Country producing whiskey and other alcoholic drinks

parts.note: Whiskey is the NATO phonetic alphabet word for W
ales are beers, drinks other than whiskey

explanation.surface: A nation renowned for its spirits and beers.
explanation.definitionFit: Wales is one of the four nations making up the United Kingdom.

clue.text: Toiletry can harm Ed badly

indicators.note: badly suggests the letters are put together wrongly, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man named Ed may be hurt by a tin of something from the bathroom shelf.
explanation.definitionFit: A moisturising lotion rubbed into the skin is a typical bathroom toiletry.

clue.text: Glue one's china broken in domestic chores

indicators.note: broken china suggests pieces scattered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Gluing a smashed cup is part of the household jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: Housecleaning is the routine of tidying and cleaning a home, typical chores.

clue.text: Penny has licence to provide bromide

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for penny in British money
latitude is freedom of action, the same as licence

explanation.surface: A coin is allowed to supply a sedative.
explanation.walkthrough: Bromide looks like the sedative chemical, but it also means a trite, soothing remark.
explanation.definitionFit: A bromide in its figurative sense is a stale, comforting cliché, just like a hackneyed saying.

clue.text: Scavenger has a bit of a laugh about money

indicators.note: about tells us the laugh sits around the currency

parts.note: ha is a single burst of laughter
the yen is the currency of Japan

explanation.surface: A carrion eater gets some amusement out of cash.
explanation.definitionFit: The African laughing beast feeds largely on carcasses left by other predators.

clue.text: Brilliant being of royal Peruvian lineage

parts.note: Incan relates to the Inca, the ruling dynasty of ancient Peru
descent is ancestry or lineage

explanation.surface: A dazzling person descended from Peru's ancient rulers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Being of' is a link, reading the whole as 'of Incan descent'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something glowing white-hot is dazzlingly bright, so brilliant in the literal sense.

clue.text: Many learn wrongly he never quite made it

indicators.note: wrongly says these letters are set out incorrectly, so rearranged

explanation.surface: Lots of people misunderstand someone who fell short.
explanation.definitionFit: A nearly man is one who repeatedly comes close to success without achieving it.

clue.text: Sparkling silver bits discarded

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
litter is scraps of rubbish thrown away

explanation.surface: Shiny fragments of silverware have been thrown out.
explanation.definitionFit: Aglitter means glittering, shining with sparkle.

clue.text: Specification for booth on a street

parts.note: a stand is a stall or booth at a fair
RD is short for road, a street

explanation.surface: A requirement for a kiosk on a road.
explanation.definitionFit: A standard is a required level or norm, like a technical specification.

clue.text: Sick during plane trip at dusk

indicators.note: during places the illness within the journey

parts.note: a flight is a journey by aeroplane
ailing means unwell

explanation.surface: Someone is unwell on an aeroplane journey at twilight.
explanation.definitionFit: The dimming daylight of evening is a phrase for twilight or nightfall.

clue.text: Doctor doses American in Ukraine

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with, so these letters are altered

explanation.surface: A physician gives a US patient medicine in Ukraine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like a noun but is the verb, tamper.
explanation.definitionFit: Odessa is the Black Sea port city located in Ukraine.

clue.text: Rabbi fills report of puncture

indicators.note: fills means goes inside the other word

parts.note: a piece is a newspaper article or report

explanation.surface: A religious leader completes an account of a flat tyre.
explanation.definitionFit: To pierce is to make a hole through something, to puncture it.

clue.text: Practise making cloth

definitions.meaning: to rehearse or train by repetition

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: repetitive training and a hard-wearing twill fabric.

clue.text: Distress a soldier getting French comedian working

parts.note: GI is an American private soldier
Jacques Tati was the French comic actor of Monsieur Hulot films
on means functioning or operating

explanation.surface: A soldier is upset by a French comic at work.
explanation.definitionFit: Agitation is a state of anxiety or disturbance, a kind of distress.

clue.text: Horrify a European when climbing

indicators.note: climbing in a down clue means this word reads upwards

parts.note: a Lapp is a person from Lapland in northern Europe

explanation.surface: A continental mountaineer causes alarm.
explanation.definitionFit: To appal is to shock or dismay, to horrify.

clue.text: Odd Frenchman interrupts pop musician playing the guitar

indicators.note: interrupts puts the two pieces into the middle of the singer's name

parts.note: Sting is the English pop singer, formerly of The Police
rum means strange or odd in British slang
M is short for Monsieur, a Frenchman

explanation.surface: A strange French visitor breaks in on a pop star at his guitar.
explanation.definitionFit: Strumming is brushing the fingers across guitar strings, a way of playing it.

clue.text: Exercise skill when returning to old city

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercise

indicators.note: returning means this word is read backwards

parts.note: art means skill or knack

explanation.surface: A workout routine practised on going back to an ancient town.
explanation.definitionFit: Petra is the ancient rock-cut city of the Nabataeans in Jordan.

clue.text: Fire survivor is resting, having gone crazy

parts.note: abed means in bed, so resting

indicators.note: crazy says the letters of the following word go haywire

explanation.surface: Someone who escaped a blaze lies in bed, having lost their mind.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Book of Daniel, Abednego survived the fiery furnace with Shadrach and Meshach.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical figure was thrown into Nebuchadnezzar's furnace and emerged unharmed.

clue.text: Red-faced girl's relieved

parts.note: Flo is a girl's name, short for Florence
rid means freed or relieved of something

explanation.surface: A blushing young woman is reassured.
explanation.definitionFit: Florid describes a ruddy, flushed complexion.
